partial_progress.details: Phases 1 and 2 landed cleanly and are lean_verify-clean. Phase 3's general truth lemma was found to be false via a concrete counterexample: for phi0 := not(diamond(diamond(box p))), modalTableauKb5' phi0 opens a branch with raw edges 0->1->2, T(box p)@2 in b, T(p)@0 not in b, and (extractModelKb5 b acc).r 2 0 holds (proved). The root cause is structural: modalKb5BoxAllFull's non-root cluster-dump arm unconditionally excludes target 0 for any non-root trigger, while the closure's global symmetry lets any two-hop-connected non-root trigger reach root in the model. modalApplyOneKb5' is frozen (task 524) so this cannot be fixed within this task's scope.
